title: Bas Ronan, Arjatay Aj Do Vichray
body:
Bas Ronan, Arjatay Aj Do Vichray Behan Bhira Da
<<DIVIDER>>
Shala Veer Kisay Day Vichran Na X2
Jivain Vichraya Hai Sughara Da
<<DIVIDER>>
Matam Ay Ki Khadi Jupni Nahi Ainj Wazi Ravani Rukhni Nahi X2
Kis Mu Naal Jannat Javarn Gaye X2
Jina Khoyaa Haq Sayeda Da
<<DIVIDER>>
Do Teer Di Kar Manzoor Duah Mola Sadqa Matamdaran Da X2
Vekha Ujardya Dera Jakenay X2
Akbar Di Maa Leanda
